description: Source code for classes and methods related to E2SM RC control actions, specifically for DU executor handling slice-level PRB quota control, including parsing RAN parameters, executing control actions, and converting requests/responses.

classes.name: e2sm_rc_control_action_du_executor_base
classes.description: Base class providing common functionality for E2SM RC control action executors, including getting action ID, name, control action definition, and returning control failure.

classes.name: e2sm_rc_control_action_2_6_du_executor
classes.description: Derived class implementing specific control action (ID 6) for slice-level PRB quota, including parsing parameters, executing control actions, and converting requests/responses.

methods.name: get_control_action_definition
methods.description: Constructs and returns the control action definition with parameters.

methods.name: return_ctrl_failure
methods.description: Returns an asynchronous task indicating control failure.

methods.name: parse_action_ran_parameter_value
methods.description: Parses RAN parameter values based on parameter ID and updates control configuration.

methods.name: ric_control_action_supported
methods.description: Checks if the control request is supported based on available parameters.

methods.name: execute_ric_control_action
methods.description: Executes the control action, including validation, logging, and invoking configuration.

methods.name: convert_to_du_config_request
methods.description: Converts a control request into DU MAC scheduler configuration.

methods.name: convert_to_e2sm_response
methods.description: Converts DU configuration response into E2SM control response.
